activity.notes: Yurii Hlushko, also known as Hlushko-Mova, headed the Ukrainian Far Eastern Secretariat and the organized Ukrainian movement in Green Ukraine/Zelenyi Klyn during 1918–1922. This records leadership of an organized national community and autonomy movement, without asserting that a sovereign Green Ukraine state or uncontested territorial government was established. The submitted suffix Malyatinsky is not adopted as a verified personal name.
